_comment: Template for appsettings.Production.json — copied here by install-service.ps1 on first install. EDIT EVERY VALUE BELOW before starting the service. Never commit a filled-in copy of this file to source control (see docs/deployment.md).

ConnectionStrings._comment: Use a dedicated SQL Server login with only the permissions this app needs (db_datareader/db_datawriter/db_ddladmin on this one database) — never 'sa'.

Jwt._comment: Generate a real random 256-bit+ key, e.g. in PowerShell: [Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::GetBytes(64)). Rotating this key invalidates every issued access/refresh token.

Database._comment: Both left off in production on purpose — run migrate.ps1 and create-admin.ps1 as deliberate, reviewed steps (Section 35) instead of migrating/seeding automatically on every service start.

Kestrel._comment: Section 33's example server address is https://ntnp-pricing-server:7240 — adjust the port/host as needed. See docs/deployment.md 'HTTPS certificate' for how to obtain Certificate:Path/Password.
